originals.why: Here isio takes a noun object and means 'want (children)', not the 'didn't want to ~' sense this LEGO teaches. The Korean can't use the gloss 싶어하지 않았어. '아이를 갖고 싶어하지 않았어' would point to 'isio cael plant' instead, so the prompt has more than one answer.
